action.command:
cd /workspace
php artisan key:generate 2>&1
echo "KEY_EXIT:$?"
mkdir -p database && touch database/database.sqlite
php artisan migrate 2>&1 | tail -30
echo "MIGRATE_EXIT:${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
